summary:
w123 planned: work status (r16-r18) and work note (r19-r21), six scenarios, 12 test ids, all red at undefined steps and missing subcommands.
New modules scripts/workqueue_status.py and scripts/workqueue_note.py, wired in scripts/work, with CLAUDE.md rows; two new step modules imported by test_work_queue.py.
Added scripts/model_work.py so model check skips ledger.md (the-ledger-is-tracked; r27 is about parts). supervise*.py left out, open-question and push rules rebuilt locally.
Decisions: the initiative branch is the checkout's HEAD (glossary; work-file-forms has no branch field); the ledger line is '- YYYY-MM-DD: <note>' like work answer; no-argument status joins the per-initiative blocks; JSON is one object with an initiatives list; note refuses line breaks first, then commits through workqueue.committed.
r20's Thens are already defined (test_work_queue.py imports * from git_steps).
Tests broken: none (verified).
